description: The Phase-2 test plan + the phase-completion gate. Extends the cross-tenant escape suite + its helper to the two new tenant-owned tables (student_profile_history append-only, student_documents standard-pair) with read/spoofed-write/foreign-parent/buggy-query/three-GUC-fail-closed assertions + the RLS-forced policy meta-test + append-only enforcement; adds the four roadmap-named behavioral tests (permitted-mutable-field enforcement, no-duplicate-identity on create/register/re-import, preserve-history, self-service active-module scoping); adds the GatePass/allowance/reliability regression suite proving the generalization is non-breaking; then runs the full CLEAN build sequence + full vitest run (all green, incl. the pre-existing suite) and a live smoke against Supabase. Depends on FEAT-001 (schema/migration) + FEAT-002 (routes).
steps: Read c:/campusgate/.agents/tasks/phase2-sis/context.json FIRST (it replaces re-exploration), then this file + design.md sections 9.1 and 11 + FEAT-001/FEAT-002 findings. Study apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/helpers/tenant-escape-setup.ts (RLS_TABLES, EXPECTED_POLICIES, DEFAULT_POLICIES, SeededTenant, seedTenant, cleanup, countRemainingTestRows) and apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/tenant-escape.integration.test.ts (the existing read/spoofed-write/buggy-query cases + the pg_class ENABLE+FORCE and pg_policies meta-test).

tenant-escape-setup.ts: add "student_profile_history" and "student_documents" to RLS_TABLES. Add student_profile_history: ["tenant_isolation_select", "student_profile_history_tenant_insert"] to EXPECTED_POLICIES (append-only pair). Do NOT add student_documents to EXPECTED_POLICIES (it must fall through to DEFAULT_POLICIES = the standard pair; adding it would be wrong). Add studentDocumentId to SeededTenant + seed one student_documents row per tenant via adminClient (overlapping-shaped, child of the seeded studentProfile). Give the generalized student_profiles seed row status (defaults ACTIVE) + optional structured links. Do NOT seed student_profile_history (the BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger blocks even adminClient in shared teardown — the audit_events / academic_calendar_day_revisions precedent). Add student_documents to cleanup (child-first, before studentProfile, because its composite FK is ON DELETE RESTRICT) and to countRemainingTestRows; leave student_profile_history out of both.

tenant-escape.integration.test.ts: add assertions for the new tables — (a) read escape: as tenant A, reading B's student_documents by id/list/nested-include returns empty/not-found; (b) spoofed-tenant write: inserting a student_documents row with institutionId=B under A's context → RLS WITH CHECK rejection / zero rows; (c) foreign-parent: creating a student_document referencing B's studentProfileId under A → composite FK violation; (d) deliberately-buggy query: an unfiltered student_documents / generalized-student_profiles findMany under A returns only A's rows; (e) missing-context fail-closed: a query without app.current_institution_id returns zero rows; (f) append-only enforcement (self-contained, within ONE tenant, no teardown): insert a student_profile_history row then assert campass_app UPDATE and DELETE on it are both denied by the trigger+REVOKE. Extend the policy meta-test so student_profile_history is asserted append-only (has tenant_isolation_select + student_profile_history_tenant_insert and NO tenant_isolation_modify) and student_documents standard-pair, both ENABLE+FORCE.

Add the permitted-mutable-field enforcement test: PATCH /students/:id with a forbidden key (enrollmentNo, status, programId, semester, departmentId) → 400 'field not editable' (zod .strict()); with only permitted keys → 200 and exactly those fields changed + a StudentProfileHistory UPDATED row written.

Add the no-duplicate-identity tests: POST /students with an existing enrollmentNo → 409 and no second row (count unchanged); /register with an enrollmentNo already present → 409 (existing behavior preserved); the roadmap re-import test — bulk-import a CSV containing an existing enrollmentNo → the existing row is UPDATED not duplicated, results.updated increments, results.created does not, the row count for that enrollmentNo stays 1, and a direct second insert of the same enrollmentNo is rejected by the enrollmentNo UNIQUE backstop.

Add the preserve-history test: promote/transfer/deactivate each write a history row with correct previous/new snapshots + actor; the history table rejects UPDATE/DELETE (append-only); no student row is ever deleted (no delete route; an attempted FK-parent delete is RESTRICT-refused); promote leaves prior history rows byte-identical.

Add the self-service scoping test: GET /me/profile returns only the caller's own record (a second student cannot see the first's — own-userId resolution + RLS); GET /me/services lists only ACTIVE-module services and flipping a module to SUSPENDED/ENTITLED removes it from the list.

Add the GatePass/allowance/reliability regression suite (design §9.1): create a student the new way then run request -> approve -> exit -> return a full gate-pass lifecycle against the generalized row; assert allowance summary + enforcement decision compute identically for a student with status=ACTIVE + null structured links AND for one with populated links; assert reliability snapshot computes unchanged; assert a GRADUATED student's historical passes still read.

Full CLEAN build from a pristine install (repo root): npm ci; (cd packages/shared && npx tsc); npx prisma generate --schema=packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma; (cd apps/api && npx tsc); npm run build — all succeed.

Full suite + live smoke: cd apps/api && npx vitest run — the entire suite green (the pre-existing tests plus all new Phase-2 tests, including the real-DB escape/behavioral/regression suites reading the untouched apps/api/.env + packages/db/.env; retry transient pooler P1001 errors). Live smoke: confirm the API boots after migrate deploy, a students.* admin route serves, and /me/profile returns the caller's record.
acceptance_criteria: The escape suite covers student_profile_history (append-only) and student_documents (standard-pair): cross-tenant read denied, spoofed-tenant write rejected, foreign-parent composite-FK violation, the deliberately-buggy unfiltered-query backstop returns only the caller's rows, missing-GUC fail-closed returns zero rows, and campass_app UPDATE/DELETE on student_profile_history is denied.
The RLS-forced policy meta-test asserts both new tables ENABLE+FORCE with the correct policy set (student_profile_history append-only with no modify policy; student_documents standard pair).
The four roadmap-named tests pass: permitted-mutable-field enforcement, no-duplicate-identity (incl. re-import update-not-duplicate), preserve-history, self-service active-module scoping.

The GatePass/allowance/reliability regression suite passes, proving the generalization is additive (identical behavior with null and populated structured links; GRADUATED student's passes still read).
The full CLEAN build sequence succeeds and cd apps/api && npx vitest run is ALL green (the pre-existing suite plus the new tests).
verification: cd c:/campusgate && npm ci && (cd packages/shared && npx tsc) && npx prisma generate --schema=packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma && (cd apps/api && npx tsc) && npm run build
